Name: Elzabad, Son of Shemaiah
Summary: Son of Shemaiah son of Obed-edom, whose brethren were strong men.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 26:7: Son of Shemaiah son of Obed-edom, whose brethren were strong men.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Elzabad stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
